invariant_facts.context: A coordinator is already responsible for two deliverables due on Thursday when the manager assigns another substantial deliverable for the same day.
invariant_facts.conflict_trigger: The coordinator tells the manager that the new deadline conflicts with existing commitments.
invariant_facts.source_of_disagreement: The disagreement concerns whether all three substantial deliverables can reasonably be completed by Thursday.
invariant_facts.organizational_consequence: Without reprioritization, at least one of the scheduled deliverables may not be completed by the deadline.

evaluation_question: Assess conflict severity, aggression, cooperativeness, attribution of responsibility, appropriate conflict-management strategy, escalation level, and a suitable managerial response.

DC.message: I already have two substantial deliverables due Thursday, and this adds a third. I cannot complete all three by Thursday. We need to change a deadline or priority.

DI.message: I already have two substantial deliverables scheduled for Thursday, and this assignment creates a third concurrent deadline. Completing all three by Thursday is not feasible. We need to revise a deadline or priority.

MC.message: I wanted to flag that I already have two substantial deliverables due Thursday, and this adds a third. I cannot complete all three by Thursday. Could we change a deadline or priority?
